info.title: WANX Octop · chat
info.description:
**CentaurAI-WANX** is a smarter, self-hosted AI assistant for multiple users and agents. All routes are served under `/api`.

## Authentication

Most endpoints require a JWT bearer token:

1. Complete initial setup via `/api/setup/*` (first install only).
2. `GET /api/auth/captcha` then `POST /api/auth/login` with `username` and `password`
   (and `captcha_token` when a strong provider is active), or complete SSO with
   `/api/auth/oidc/*` or `/api/auth/oauth/*` when a provider is enabled.
3. Send `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` on subsequent requests.

Access tokens use sliding renewal: when less than one-third of
`access_token_ttl_seconds` remains, authenticated responses may include a fresh
token in the `X-Octop-Access-Token` header. Clients should replace the stored
token when present.

Public endpoints (no login token): `/api/docs`, `/api/openapi.json`, `/api/health`,
`/api/setup/*` (wizard authorization applies), `/api/auth/login`, `/api/auth/register`,
`/api/auth/captcha`, `/api/auth/oidc/status`, `/api/auth/oidc/start`,
`/api/auth/oidc/callback`, `/api/auth/oidc/exchange`, `/api/auth/oauth/status`,
`/api/auth/oauth/start`, `/api/auth/oauth/callback`, `/api/auth/oauth/exchange`,
`/api/auth/invite/validate`,
`/api/auth/invite/redeem`, `/api/connectors/oauth/callback`,
and `/api/internal/mcp/*`.

## Agent scope

Many agent-scoped routes use the agent ID in the URL path (`/api/agents/{agent_id}/…`).
Routes first check the signed token's application scope; legacy tokens default to WANX.
Resources in another application are treated as not found, including for administrators.
Within the same application, each route applies its ownership or shared-resource access
rules. WANX administrators may bypass ownership where supported; Zhijun personal profiles,
memories and uploaded sources require the owner.

## Streaming chat

Dashboard live turns use **WebSocket** at `/api/agents/{agent_id}/chat/ws` (pass JWT as
`?token=` query param). Send `{"type":"user_turn", ...}` frames; the server replies with JSON
chunks matching the harness stream format, ending with `{"type":"done"}` or
`{"type":"error","message":"..."}`.

Text-type dashboard pushes (cron reminders, proactive care) also emit
`{"type":"dashboard_push", ...}` on `/api/notifications/ws` (same `?token=` auth) so the
SPA can show a toast even when the chat socket is not subscribed.

HITL resume still uses `POST /api/agents/{agent_id}/chat/hitl/resume` (SSE).

## Knowledge libraries

`/api/knowledge-bases` uses the signed application scope for creation, visibility,
document access, and citations. Existing libraries remain in WANX. Zhijun libraries
are private to their owner and use local document parsers, downloaded native ONNX
embeddings and RapidOCR. Remote WANX embedding/OCR settings do not affect Zhijun;
missing local components are reported as unavailable without remote fallback.

get.description: Owner and box scoped. Includes native channel conversations and their channel_type without copying history. Internal answer-version threads are grouped under the original conversation.

schema.title: Response Assistant Conversations List Api Assistant Conversations Get

get.summary: Read assistant conversation sources and versions
get.description: Restores saved source choices without granting MCP access. Revalidates available sources; unavailable choices are retained with explicit validation_errors.

patch.summary: Update conversation sources or selected answer version
patch.description: Uses revision compare-and-swap. Source preferences are separate from two-hour grants. Disabling access revokes all capabilities for this conversation, including connected MCP reads. New access and version switches are blocked while a turn or confirmation is pending.

post.summary: Remember the most recently opened assistant conversation
post.description: Records navigation for the current account on this box after validating conversation ownership. Does not change source selections, versions or grants.

post.summary: Create an edit or regenerate version without deleting history
post.description: Clones only the history before the target request; no tool execution is replayed. Stable message IDs and ownership are required. Returns prepared_content only to the authenticated trusted client for the next native turn; this route does not invoke a model.

post.summary: Ensure the current user's private general assistant
post.description: WANX accounts only. Reuses an owned private default-template expert, or creates one using the user's existing workspace/resource policies. Repeated and concurrent calls share the same binding. Does not generate a chat turn or change model settings.

get.summary: Read this user's assistant history organization
get.description: Account and box scoped names, pins, archives and recoverable trash. Source conversations are retained.

post.summary: Organize assistant history, including batch operations
post.description: Validates ownership of all selected conversations before an atomic update. Trash is reversible; no messages or checkpoints are deleted.

post.summary: Choose or revoke an assistant's read-only space scope
post.description: Off by default. Explicitly select all owned spaces, one space, or one folder subtree. Grants are owner-bound, thread-bound on first send, expire after two hours without renewal, and are checked on every MCP read. Revocation stops subsequent reads including an ongoing turn.

get.summary: Read previously retrieved source references in an owned assistant conversation
List owned personal or authorized team knowledge warehouses
Read warehouse assistant access and team members (admin)

put.summary: Authorize all or selected team members for assistant knowledge (admin)
put.description: Transactional, revision-checked warehouse ACL. New members inherit all-member rules; selected rules require explicit membership. Revocation applies to ongoing MCP calls.

post.summary: Choose or revoke this conversation's read-only Starlink warehouses
post.description: Off until explicitly configured. Owner and box bound, one thread, two-hour expiry renewed on send. Does not modify expert defaults or Starlink documents.

post.summary: Preview protected evidence from a currently selected warehouse

get.description:
Welcome copy for the empty chat screen.

Resolution order:
1. Agent row ``welcome_message`` (instance-owned; set at create/edit).
2. Agent workspace ``.octop/manifest.json`` (seeded at create; quick cards + fallback copy).
3. Default quick cards (``general-assistant`` or a small built-in set).

Team hosts keep the team intro and show members' own quick cards — the host
is not turned into cards.

delete.description:
Remove a conversation thread, its actual checkpoint data, and its metadata.

Checkpoint deletion runs first: if it fails (as opposed to simply
finding nothing to delete — agent not running / no checkpointer),
the row is intentionally left in place so the thread stays visible
and the caller can retry, instead of orphaning undeleted data with
no remaining handle to it.

get.description:
Return a page of trajectory events for a thread (newest page by default).

List payloads omit message bodies (``content`` / ``text`` / ``thinking``) but
include clipped tool ``args`` / ``result`` for ledger rendering. Use the
event detail endpoint for full payloads.
